reviewScope: All 604 stills were reviewed in 13 contact sheets. 198 initial candidates and two burst/panorama alternatives were compared at up to 500 pixels per image; the cover, Supertree pair and unstitched tree view received additional 1500-pixel inspection.
dateSource: All active selections use camera-local EXIF DateTimeOriginal. Pixel originals retain their recorded +08:00 offset; older cameras have no offset tag, which remains null rather than invented. UTC Pixel filenames are not used as local calendar dates. Undated shared copies are omitted.
locationNotes: Original GPS, readable signs, landmarks and chronological context establish locations; precise GPS values are kept outside the published content.

The 29 December 2019 decoration stall is in Jurong East, not Chinatown. The 19 January 2020 elevated railway is in Bukit Panjang. Camera evidence takes precedence over assumptions based on other collection days.
The Botanic Gardens entrance reads Centre for Ethnobotany. The Southern Ridges route is supported by GPS and the Marang Trail and Faber Walk signs.
The eclipse gathering is at the NUS multipurpose field in Kent Ridge, supported by original GPS and the university’s account of the 26 December 2019 event.

The 23 September 2023 ferry sequence supports the broader Southern Islands label; exact island names are not assigned without sufficient photographic evidence. Other uncertain 2023 sites retain the broader Singapore label.
Only selected WebP derivatives belong in public/photos/singapore and R2. Originals, videos, contact sheets, private documents and credentials remain outside the website.
criteria: Use the owner’s original photographs; choose distinct scenery, architecture, nature, food, art, performances and daily life.
Prefer clear, well-composed photographs over quantity. Short days remain short; repeated bursts and weak frames are not used to reach a target.
Keep dates and locations chronological, show labels in every section and image, and hide the chapter index.
Count the cover once in the album and its capture day; do not repeat it in the gallery.
Correct EXIF orientation, preserve the complete frame and original colour, and export WebP at quality 84 and at most 2000 pixels, or 2400 for the cover. Strip EXIF/XMP.
Allow public crowds, local people, performances and a candid walker. Record people scenes for later review without identifying or matching faces.
Keep travel documents, certificates, medical or booking records, screenshots and private references out of the gallery, exports, R2 and Git.
